ops.title: Graphite sync state across yasyf's repos, and what gates the gt lane
ops.body:
Measured 2026-07-26 with gt 1.8.6.

**Every `Forge-AI/*` repo is Graphite-synced; every `yasyf/*` repo is not.** `gt auth --no-interactive` exits 0 with `✅ Ready to submit PRs to <owner>/<repo>` on the former and exits 1 with `ERROR: Graphite does not have the necessary permissions to submit PRs to <owner>/<repo>.` on the latter.

Repos carrying a live `.git/.graphite_repo_config`: `cc-context`, `cc-review`, `cc-transcript` (all unsynced → `ccx vcs ship` takes the gt lane and fails at `gt submit` after cutting the commit), plus `monorepo` and `interview-tools` (synced, fine). `cc-skills` and `cc-notes` no longer have the config, though both still carry `.git/.graphite_metadata.db` from an earlier `gt init`.

**The config carries no repo identity** — it is `{trunk, trunks, lastFetchedPRInfoMs, lastFetchedFeatureFlagsInMs}`, identical in every repo that has one. Neither `.graphite_metadata.db` (branch parentage only) nor `.graphite_pr_info` (a PR cache, empty in synced-but-PR-less repos too) nor `~/.config/graphite/*` is repo-scoped. So a config cannot be "stale" in the owner/name sense, and **no local file can answer whether gt can submit here** — only the server can, which is what `gt auth`'s ~1.5 s round-trip buys.

`gt auth` sharp edges: it hangs indefinitely when offline (prints `Could not connect to the Graphite server` then never exits — needs an external timeout); `-q` suppresses the `✅` line while keeping the exit code, breaking any strict predicate; exit 0 with no `✅` line happens outside a git repo or with no remote, so exit code alone false-positives; unauthenticated is a distinct failure (`No auth token set`) wanting a different message. It rewrites `.git/.graphite_pr_info` but creates no config, so probing cannot flip lane detection on.

Separately: `.orca` worktrees have `.git` as a **file** (a gitdir pointer), so `.git/.graphite_repo_config` never resolves there and ship silently takes the jj/git lane in every monorepo worktree.
